definitions.explanation: Rated as clearly above standard. Applied to goods, companies, properties, borrowers, and school records — typically in official or commercial assessments rather than casual praise.

examples.japanese: {優良|ゆうりょう}な⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{優良|ゆうりょう}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This company is known as a blue-chip firm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{近|ちか}く⟦{日当|ひあ}たり→日当たり：07498_hiatari⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧よい{優良|ゆうりょう}⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{手|て}→買い手：24770_kaite⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついた。
examples.english: It was a prime property, close to the station and with good sunlight, so a buyer turned up right away.

notes:
Used mostly as a prefix-like modifier in compounds; the standalone な form is possible but less common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {優良|ゆうりょう}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: blue-chip company
- {優良|ゆうりょう}⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧: prime property
- {優良|ゆうりょう}⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧: valued customer
- {優良|ゆうりょう}{運転者|うんてんしゃ}: driver with a clean record

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧: excellent — used of people's ability and performance; {優良|ゆうりょう} is used of things and organizations
- ⟦{良質|りょうしつ}→良質：13949_ryoushitsu⟧: good quality — about the material or content itself, without the official-rating flavor
